# TestScript for 26-library-embedding
# Asserts hosted lifecycle: App.Args, injected Stdout/Stderr/Stdin streams,
# RunContext, typed errors + *conga.UsageError, custom Exit handler,
# UsageOnError(UsageSilence), and the Disable* built-in switches

# 1. Successful run: the command reads the injected stdin, business output
#    lands in the injected stdout buffer, the custom exit handler records 0,
#    and the host exits cleanly
exec library-embedding migrate-data --priority 7
stdout '\[host\] captured exit code: 0'
stdout 'Running job migrate-data \(priority 7\)'
stdout 'stdin payload: "host-provided stdin\\n"'
! stdout 'usage error at command path'

# 2. Coercion failure: the host inspects the typed error (*conga.UsageError,
#    CommandPath, ExitCode) and performs the exit itself with code 2
exit-status 2 library-embedding migrate-data --priority notanumber
stdout '\[host\] run error: invalid integer value "notanumber" for flag --priority'
stdout '\[host\] usage error at command path: library-embedding'
stdout '\[host\] usage error exit code: 2'
stdout '\[host\] captured exit code: 2'

# 3. Missing required positional argument (a usage error)
exit-status 2 library-embedding
stdout '\[host\] run error: missing required positional argument <job>'
stdout '\[host\] usage error exit code: 2'
stdout '\[host\] captured exit code: 2'

# 4. Disabled built-ins: --help is just an unknown flag now
exit-status 2 library-embedding --help
stdout '\[host\] run error: unknown flag: --help'
stdout '\[host\] usage error exit code: 2'
stdout '\[host\] captured exit code: 2'

# 5. UsageOnError(UsageSilence): the friendly error renders without any usage dump
exit-status 2 library-embedding migrate-data --priority notanumber
! stdout 'Usage:'
! stdout 'usage:'
